Package io.github.libxposed.api

Class XposedModule

java.lang.Object
io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterfaceWrapper
io.github.libxposed.api.XposedModule
All Implemented Interfaces:
XposedInterface, XposedModuleInterface
public abstract class XposedModule extends XposedInterfaceWrapper implements XposedModuleInterface
Super class which all Xposed module entry classes should extend.
Entry classes will be instantiated once for each loaded module generation in a process.
